dsh-shorts-wall 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

posts.en:
dsh-shorts-wall is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7606c8f6142c63002337.html
